topic: ONLYOFFICE vs MS Word Table RTL Support

findings.onlyoffice_support: ONLYOFFICE currently lacks support for the <w:bidiVisual/> tag in w:tblPr. It completely ignores the tag and renders tables Left-to-Right (LTR).
github_issues: ONLYOFFICE/DocumentServer#3133 (Open) - Tracks missing RTL table orientation support (Internal Bug 69579).
findings.openxml_syntax_requirement: The standard OpenXML tag <w:bidiVisual/> is the correct mechanism for Right-to-Left tables. ONLYOFFICE simply has a missing feature and does not currently have any alternative tag to achieve table-level RTL mirroring.
findings.libreoffice_behavior: LibreOffice correctly interprets <w:bidiVisual/> and renders tables as Right-to-Left.
findings.ms_word_behavior: Microsoft Word natively processes <w:bidiVisual/> and flips table columns correctly.

resolution: Until ONLYOFFICE resolves internal bug 69579 (tracked in Issue #3133), the standard OpenXML <w:bidiVisual/> tag remains the officially correct approach. ONLYOFFICE users will see reversed table columns until the patch is merged upstream. We must retain <w:bidiVisual/> to preserve canonical compatibility with Microsoft Word, LibreOffice, and OpenXML standards.
